title: Live reasoning: one stream with a live agent list
question: One stream like Pi, two separate sidebars, and workers nested under each lead. The conversation replays a real Pi turn (dogsled lead, 6 Nov 12:26). The rondo lead and its three workers are the real fleet at 13:24 the same day, with their real thoughts and commands. Todos and host meters are illustrative.

options.label: One stream, live agent rows, workers under their lead
options.thesis: The conversation is the Pi session: thinking (italic) and tool calls ($ command, output tail) in recorded order, then the reply. Inbox and agents stay two separate sidebars. Each lead row shows its phase and newest thought or command. Its workers nest under it, each with its own phase and newest thought or command.
options.viewport: 1600 × 1000 at the live edge; also 1280 × 800, 900 × 800, and a history capture with the earlier turn opened.
options.risk: With the shipped columns, the conversation stays 772px wide at 1600px.
